gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed GBM with histopathological confirmation.

candidate_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered continuously from day 1 of radiotherapy to the last day of radiation at a daily oral dose of 75 mg/m2 for a maximum of 49 days.
The experimental part of the study would be this selection of resectable patients and sequencing neoadjuvant chemoradiation prior to surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed GBM with histopathological confirmation.

agents.agent_name_registered: Drug Therapy with Temozolomide (benzolamide) (Standard of Care)

role_evidence.quote: The experimental part of the study would be this selection of resectable patients and sequencing neoadjuvant chemoradiation prior to surgery.
Surgical resection of GBM will be done after radiation and Temozolomide treatment.

coder_notes: Single-arm phase II testing the sequence of standard chemoradiation (radiotherapy plus temozolomide, standard doses) given before surgery (neoadjuvant) instead of after. Temozolomide is an established GBM therapy whose setting/sequence is the question, so rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment), not a candidate. The registry calls it 'benzolamide' in places; the dose and context are temozolomide.
